headline: Shopify Shares Fall After Missing Third-Quarter Revenue Expectations
summary: Shopify's stock declined following its earnings report after the company missed revenue expectations in a less forgiving technology market.
why: Shopify Inc. is a major e-commerce platform provider enabling merchants to run online and physical stores. Earnings misses in high-valuation tech companies often trigger sharp near-term repricing.

impacts.name: Shopify Inc.
impacts.why: The company's stock slides after missing revenue expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The stock slid because the company missed revenue expectations, creating concern among investors in a less forgiving technology market.
